mississauga.populationFinding: The 2021 Census Population dashboard directly uses the AG field from 2021_Census_ESRI. The official downloadable legend defines AG as Total - Age groups of the population - 25% sample data. It can be displayed with that basis; it must not be confused with VM (population in private households) or asserted to be a 100% exact count.
mississauga.incomeFinding: The 2021 dashboard explicitly labels median/average income for people aged 15 years and over, not households. The 711-field backend was inspected and does not provide household-income median omitted from the earlier custom CSV.

peelHealthDataZones.geographyFinding: 0/56 Mississauga and 0/53 Brampton municipal neighbourhoods exactly match an HDZ; none has IoU >=95%.
peelHealthDataZones.incomeFinding: All 17 Brampton HDZ Income_MedHH values are exactly reproduced by rounding the household-count-weighted arithmetic mean of constituent 2021 census tract medians. This is a numerical inference from official snapshots, not an explicit methodology statement in the source metadata. It is not a valid median of all zone households.
peelHealthDataZones.visibleMinorityFinding: All 40 zones have source VM_Total below the sum of the 13 group counts by 240 to 3140 people. No correction is invented; rates withheld.
peelHealthDataZones.populationFinding: All 40 have published total population counts; preserved with census rounding caveat.
peelHealthDataZones.delivery: Audit-only evidence. The HDZ derived supplemental display artifacts were rejected and archived; no HDZ income or population-group rates are supplied to the application.

brampton.finding: Official NNP current 53-community population uses Environics 2022 estimates. Existing NNP boundaries match at export precision; keyed by source name then mapped to current IDs. It is not 2021 Census. Old 2016 NNP income data contain averages, not medians, and multiple boundaries have changed.
